facts.business: GPT Infraprojects Limited is a multi-disciplinary infrastructure contracting and manufacturing enterprise operating in heavy civil engineering and concrete sleeper manufacturing.

auditor.name: M S K A & Associates LLP

key_risks: Revenue recognition involves inherent estimation uncertainty relating to determination of progress of each contract, cost incurred till date and estimation of total future cost to complete remaining performance obligations
Estimation of total cost to complete contract involves significant judgement throughout the period and is subject to revision based on latest available information
Identification of contractual obligations in respect of Company's rights to receive payments for performance completed till date
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties include subsidiaries (GPT Investments Private Limited, Mauritius; GPT Concrete Products South Africa (Pty.) Limited, South Africa; RMS GPT Ghana Limited, Ghana; Jogbani Highway Private Limited; Alcon Builders and Engineers Private Limited; GPT ISC JU Highway Private Limited), joint venture (GPT – Transnamib Concrete Sleepers (Pty.) Limited, Namibia), key management personnel and their relatives, and entities controlled by KMP/relatives (GPT Castings Limited). Promoter entities pledged 4,45,00,682 shares as additional security towards credit facilities. KMP remuneration for 2025-26 was Rs 967.48 lakhs.
